name: Camera dei deputati
notes: 400 seats, XIX legislature (elected 25 September 2022). Who sits and their parliamentary group are from the Chamber's own lists; names there are SURNAME Name, so matches by name are printed for checking. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Senato della Repubblica
notes: 200 elected senators plus senators for life, XIX legislature. Who sits and their group are from the Senate's open data (dati.senato.it). The seat count is the number of senators sitting, since senators for life are not part of the 200. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
